descriptionHtml:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our team and culture make us unique — we’re driven by impact and growth, where every one of us strives to learn and excel. Recognised by Sifted’s Rising 100 and LinkedIn's Top Startups, we’re here to help propel your career and together, make Moss a lasting success.

We are hiring an Applied AI Engineer to design, build, and deploy AI-powered products that transform how finance teams work. You will work with frontier language models to create intelligent services, agents, and workflows that deliver real customer value.

Your Responsibilities

Build AI-Powered Products

  • Design, develop, and deploy AI-enabled applications and services using state-of-the-art language models.
  • Build intelligent agents and workflows that automate complex finance processes.
  • Experiment with new AI capabilities and rapidly turn prototypes into production-ready features.


Evaluate and Improve AI Systems

  • Develop robust evaluation frameworks to measure quality, reliability, and business impact.
  • Improve model performance through prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and other applied AI techniques.
  • Ensure AI systems are accurate, trustworthy, and deliver a high-quality user experience.


Design for Trust and Control

  • Build AI systems that are transparent, auditable, and allow users to review and intervene when needed.
  • Incorporate customer data into AI workflows while maintaining security and privacy standards.


Collaborate Across Functions

  • Partner closely with product managers, designers, engineers, and finance experts to deliver customer-facing AI solutions.
  • Help shape Moss's AI product strategy and engineering best practices.


About You

  • Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 4 years of professional engineering experience building and shipping production applications.
  • Proven experience working with modern LLMs and AI application development.
  • Strong programming skills in both Python and Java.
  • Experience building backend services and APIs.
  • Hands-on experience with AI agents, RAG systems, prompt engineering, or related applied AI techniques.
  • Ability to balance rapid experimentation with production-quality engineering.
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.


Relevant Technologies

Candidates should have experience with a subset of the following technologies and be eager to learn others.

AI & Machine Learning

  • Frontier LLMs: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, or similar
  • Agent and orchestration frameworks: LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack, or similar
  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  • Prompt engineering and evaluation methodologies
  • Fine-tuning and model adaptation techniques


Software Engineering

  • Python and Java
  • REST APIs and backend application development
  • SQL and modern data storage technologies
  • Distributed systems and scalable application design


Nice to Have

  • Experience building customer-facing AI products
  • Experience in fintech, finance, or enterprise software
  • Experience with cloud-based AI platforms such as Vertex AI, OpenAI, or Anthropic APIs


About Moss

Moss is a SaaS scale-up founded in Berlin, with a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities in 5 offices across Europe.

Our ambition is bold: to power every SMB’s spend across Europe - fully digital, AI-driven, and seamlessly integrated for complete control. To date, over 5000 businesses in Germany, Netherlands and the UK use Moss’ leading spend management product, with modules such as corporate cards, accounts payables, employee cash reimbursements and procurement.

Moss has raised a total of €180 million in funding and is backed by the most renowned tech investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures and A-Star.

Be Part Of a Culture That Thrives On Impact And Speed, Where You Can Take Bold Moves, Learn Fast And Accomplish More. We’re a Place Where You Can Fast Track Your Career - Here's What Else To Expect

  • Top-of-market compensation package, including equity.
  • Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos.
  • Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits.


Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).

By applying for the above position, you will confirm that you have reviewed and agreed to our Data Privacy Policy.

descriptionHtml:
Stellen-ID: 288593

Bei Vodafone arbeiten wir jeden Tag an einer besseren Zukunft. Für eine Welt, die besser vernetzt, inklusiver und nachhaltiger ist. Denn für uns ist Technologie nur so stark wie die Menschen, die sie nutzen. Sei dabei und lass uns gemeinsam die Welt von morgen gestalten.

Was Dich erwartet:

  • Du steuerst als Expert Cloud Data Engineer (m/w/d) das VOIS-Entwicklungsteam für verschiedene Cloud-Plattformen und verantwortest das Design sowie die Implementierung von Modulen einer analytischen bzw. ML-Anwendung in der Cloud (Google Cloud, AWS, Private Cloud)
  • Du übernimmst die Steuerung von Operations-Aufgaben in der Cloud, wie Monitoring, Incident- und Problem-Management, in einem DevSecOps-Team und entwickelst ausführbare Images (Docker-Container)
  • Du automatisierst Machine-Learning-Modelle und ML-Pipelines unter Verwendung einer serverlosen Architektur und unterstützt die Anwender:innen bei der Nutzung von Cloud-Diensten
  • Du verantwortest die Entwicklung von ausführbaren Images (Docker-Containern) und automatisierst Machine-Learning-Modelle sowie ML-Pipelines unter Verwendung einer serverlosen Architektur
  • Du unterstützt die Anwender:innen bei der Nutzung von Cloud-Diensten und entwickelst Lösungen zur Analyse und Visualisierung von Daten


Was Dich auszeichnet:

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Data Science, Mathematik, Physik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mindestens vier Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der Big-Data- oder Cloud-Entwicklung
  • Zertifizierung als Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer oder eine vergleichbare Zertifizierung im AWS-Umfeld
  • Gute Kenntnisse einer Cloud-Plattform (GCP oder AWS)
  • Gute Erfahrung mit serverlosen Infrastrukturen sowie dem Aufbau und Betrieb von Docker-Containern (z. B. Kubernetes, Podman, Minikube)

Diese Stelle kann in Vollzeit oder vollzeitnaher Teilzeit (mind. 30 Stunden) ausgeübt werden.

Deine Stärken und Erfahrungen zählen. Uns sind Vielfalt und gleiche Chancen wichtig. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung. Und beachten sie bei gleicher Eignung besonders.

Wir besetzen diese Stelle am Standort Düsseldorf für die Vodafone GmbH.

Was wir Dir bieten:

  • Flexibilität: Hybrid Working ermöglicht Dir die Arbeit im Büro oder bis zu 3 Tage/Woche aus dem Homeoffice. Zusätzlich kannst Du bis zu 20 Tage pro Jahr im EU-Ausland sowie in immer mehr Nicht-EU-Ländern arbeiten
  • Attraktive Vergütung und Altersvorsorge: Als Tarif-Mitarbeiter:in bekommst Du je nach Vergütungsmodell Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld oder ein 13. Gehalt. Und mit unserem Pensionsplan auch eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Weiterbildung: Du entscheidest, mit welchen unserer Lern- und Trainingsprogrammen Du Deine individuelle Entwicklung förderst
  • Work-Life-Balance: Ob Kita, Gesundheits- & Achtsamkeitsprogramme oder Fitnessstudio: Du gestaltest flexibel Deinen Job und Dein Privatleben. Wir unterstützen Dich. Auch bei der Pflege von Angehörigen
  • Rabatte und Zusatzleistungen: Als Mitarbeiter:in bekommst Du besondere Angebote auf alle unsere Produkte für Mobilfunk, Festnetz, Internet und TV.


Wer wir sind:

Vodafone feiert und fördert Diversität und Inklusion. Wir sind so verschieden wie unsere Kund:innen und unsere Gesellschaft. Ob ethnische Herkunft, Hautfarbe, Alter, Geschlechtsidentität, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung, Religion, politische Zugehörigkeit, Gewerkschaftszugehörigkeit, Nationalität, Gesundheitszustand, soziale Herkunft oder kultureller Hintergrund: Bei Vodafone ist kein Platz für Diskriminierung.

Together we can.

title: Applied AI/ML Engineer (Agents)
description: About CuspAICuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.The RoleDue to rapid growth in our core AI capabilities, we are seeking an experienced Applied AI/ML Engineer (Agents) to design and build the intelligent agents that power our autonomous materials discovery engine.Your ImpactYou will be instrumental in developing the "artificial brain" of our agentic materials discovery engine. This is responsible for orchestrating complex, closed-loop scientific workflows, autonomously making decisions, running simulations, and driving experimental campaigns to find breakthrough materials faster than ever before.Your work will directly accelerate CuspAI’s path to finding solutions for global sustainability challenges.What You Will DoAgentic systemsDesign the agentic framework that powers our platform to discover new materials. descriptionHtml:
About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

Due to rapid growth in our core AI capabilities, we are seeking an experienced Applied AI/ML Engineer (Agents) to design and build the intelligent agents that power our autonomous materials discovery engine.

Your Impact

You will be instrumental in developing the "artificial brain" of our agentic materials discovery engine. This is responsible for orchestrating complex, closed-loop scientific workflows, autonomously making decisions, running simulations, and driving experimental campaigns to find breakthrough materials faster than ever before.

Your work will directly accelerate CuspAI’s path to finding solutions for global sustainability challenges.

What You Will Do

Agentic systems

  • Design the agentic framework that powers our platform to discover new materials. This includes spanning dynamic, multi-stage simulation workflows from literature-grounded hypothesis generation through to computational and experimental validation
  • Build the integration that connects agents to ML models, simulation engines, databases, and heterogeneous compute backends
  • Design pipelines that let agents autonomously plan, schedule, execute, and interpret computational tasks at scale and over long periods of time
  • Use expert annotations from the Chemistry team to drive targeted improvements in agent planning, retrieval, and decision-making
  • Create evaluations to measure the effectiveness of agents

Experimental design

  • Build agents that perform experimental design — applying Bayesian optimization, active learning, or related sequential decision-making methods to decide what to compute or measure next, and to balance exploration and exploitation across long-running discovery campaigns
  • Help close the loop between simulation and physical experiments so that outcomes become durable knowledge — feeding back into what agents know and how their models reason — compounding across campaigns.
  • Develop strategies for multi-fidelity and multi-objective decision-making, where agents must trade off cost, time, and uncertainty across simulations and physical experiments

Interdisciplinary Collaboration

  • Work closely with Chemists, Materials Scientists, and the rest of the Agent team to co-develop our core orchestration intelligence
  • Work on customer projects and implement the direct needs required for these projects

Must Have Skills and Qualifications:

  • You are someone who gets excited about the opportunity to enable scientists to work on world changing challenges in this domain, with a personal interest in the potential applications of the technology that CuspAI is building.
  • Proficiency in the modern ML ecosystem such as PyTorch or JAX, with experience taking ML-driven systems from prototype to production
  • Strong software engineering skills (building systems at scale in a production environment): testing, modular design, CI/CD, and scalable ML operations in production environments
  • If you have a PhD or Masters degree and 4-5 yrs industry experience this would be ideal, but we will also consider you if you have a PhD and slightly less experience in industry
  • You have a proactive builder mentality with a bias toward shipping and iteration
  • Willingness to learn about materials science, and in particular experimental chemistry - to learn the vocabulary of the discipline to meaningfully interact with other stakeholders
  • Experienced in LLM-assisted programming, knowing its strengths and weaknesses thoroughly.

Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

  • Experience applying ML models specifically for materials science, chemistry, or drug discovery applications
  • Experience with agentic frameworks and building LLM-powered applications
  • Experience with sequential decision-making methods — Bayesian optimization, active learning, bandits, or reinforcement learning — applied to real-world systems
  • Advanced agentic-reasoning techniques: planning models, self-improving systems, multi-tool agents, or RLHF/RLAIF workflows

Additional Considerations

This role could be based in our Cambridge, London, Amsterdam or Berlin offices, with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to our other offices for collaboration and project oversight.

Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.

What we offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth
  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company
  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays
  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together
  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth
  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques
  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other

Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.

CuspAI is an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds and value the unique perspectives and contributions that diversity brings to our team.

Please let us know if you require any specific adjustments during or after the interview process. We will do everything we can within reason to accommodate.

Job Title: Data Integration & AI Automation Engineer

Job Category: Information Technology

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI

Employee Type: Regular-Long Term Assignment

Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%

Type of Travel: Local

* * *

The Opportunity

As a Data Integration & AI Automation Engineer supporting US Army Europe & Africa Intelligence Directorate, and the US Army Counter-Intelligence Command’s Region V, you will embed at McCully Barracks in Wackernheim, Germany, and may travel as required to perform services at other locations within the USEUCOM or USAFRICOM AOR or Area of Interest (AOI) to meet mission requirements in both CONUS and OCONUS locations. The USAREUR-AF TMISS Team will research, analyze, and produce near- and long-term all source assessments on terrorism / counterterrorism, and multi-discipline counter-intelligence issues.

Responsibilities

  • Lead enterprise data modernization and mission automation for ACIC Region V. You will engineer ontology‑driven integrations across Maven Smart Systems (MSS), Palantir Foundry, Vantage, and cArmy; design and deploy intelligent software agents that automate analytic workflows and reporting; and build real/near‑real‑time operational tracking and visualization capabilities that provide a unified counterintelligence picture across EUCOM, CENTCOM, and AFRICOM.
  • Develop and implement a holistic data ecosystem using open standards/APIs; architect data management frameworks, access models, and integration strategies to organize, correlate, analyze, and visualize approved mission data.
  • Design, test, and deploy intelligent software agents to automate complex analytical tasks, proactive anomaly detection, and auto‑generation of intelligence products (e.g., reports, situational awareness slides, SITREPs, continuity of operations maps).
  • Engineer specialized tracking and visualization tools: Exercise & Technology Tracker; GIS incident mapping for Red/Blue CI events with geocoding and temporal analysis; centralized IT status dashboards with automated alerting; DBIDS foreign‑national access tracking with watchlist cross‑references.
  • Stand up MSS decision‑support capabilities on IL6 SIPR/NIPR; integrate platform ontologies and configure hybrid multi‑cloud within ACIC’s cArmy environment; provide advanced technical support and training to government personnel.
  • Modernize manual processes by re‑engineering static Excel/PowerPoint products into dynamic, automated dashboards and templates; build secure data pipelines, templates, and AI/ML‑enabled tools to streamline operations and reduce staff time.
  • Support data governance and platform configuration; conduct data validation/quality checks; and develop/maintain technical documentation, SOPs, user guides, process maps, data‑flow diagrams, training and transition materials.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI (ability to complete a CI‑scope polygraph; SAP access eligibility may be required).
  • Education/Experience (SOFA‑mapped; meet one): Bachelor’s + 3 years; Associate’s + 7 years; Major certification + 7 years; or 11 years of recent specialized experience.
  • Hands‑on experience in data/platform integration, API engineering, and mission automation within secure, high‑availability environments.
  • Proficiency with Palantir Foundry OSDK (TypeScript, Python) and SQL; experience with big‑data tools (Apache Spark or Hadoop).
  • Experience designing secure data pipelines, entity/knowledge graph modeling, and cross‑enclave data management with tiered classification and RBAC.
  • Ability to build operational dashboards and GIS visualizations; familiarity with Tableau/Power BI and geospatial tooling (e.g., ArcGIS).
  • Strong analytical/problem‑solving skills; excellent communication and collaboration with analysts, targeteers, and operations personnel.
  • Work Setting: On‑site at McCully Barracks, Wackernheim, Germany; Core Hours 0900–1500; extended business hours as needed (mission‑driven).

Desired

  • Experience deploying MSS capabilities on IL6 SIPR/NIPR and configuring hybrid multi‑cloud environments within cArmy.
  • Demonstrated success implementing ontology‑driven peering among MSS, Foundry, and Vantage with automated workflow orchestration.
  • Background supporting ACIC or similar CI missions, including DBIDS data integration, watchlist correlation, and GIS‑based incident mapping.
  • Security Clearance & Work Setting

What You Can Expect

 A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

The Proposed Salary Range For This Position Is

$99,300 - 208,600 USD

CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

- Homeoffice möglichSie arbeiten in einem internationalen und multidisziplinären Studienteam. descriptionHtml:
Stellen-ID: 288398

Bei Vodafone arbeiten wir jeden Tag an einer besseren Zukunft. Für eine Welt, die besser vernetzt, inklusiver und nachhaltiger ist. Denn für uns ist Technologie nur so stark wie die Menschen, die sie nutzen. Sei dabei und lass uns gemeinsam die Welt von morgen gestalten.

Was Dich erwartet:

  • Du wirkst als Coordinator GCP Data Engineer (m/w/d) bei der Implementierung von analytischen Cloud-Anwendungen (Google, AWS, private Cloud) mit
  • Du betreibst Software-Engineering, insbesondere das Schreiben von Unit Tests und die Dokumentation von Data Feeds und Datentransformationsprozessen
  • Du nimmst am agilen Projektgeschehen teil (Planungstermine, Daily Stand-Ups, Retrospektiven, …)
  • Du setzt Operations-Aufgaben für die Cloud wie Monitoring und Incident Management in einem DevSecOps-Team unter fachlicher und technischer Anleitung um
  • Du wirkst bei der Automatisierung von Machine Learning Modellen und ML-Pipelines unter Verwendung einer Serverless Architecture mit


Was Dich auszeichnet:

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-) Informatik, Data Science, Mathematik, Physik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Kenntnisse einer Cloud Plattform (GCP oder AWS) sowie deren Cloud Tools (Cloud Composer, BigQuery, Data Proc, etc.)
  • Erste Erfahrungen mit serverless Infrastrukturen und Containern (docker, Kubernetes)
  • Erfahrung mit CI/CD Entwicklung und den eingesetzten Tools (Git, Jenkins, Maven, Nexus, Airflow)
  • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort- und Schrift (B2 nach GER)


Diese Stelle kann in Vollzeit oder vollzeitnaher Teilzeit (mind. 30 Stunden) ausgeübt werden.

Deine Stärken und Erfahrungen zählen. Uns sind Vielfalt und gleiche Chancen wichtig. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung. Und beachten sie bei gleicher Eignung besonders.

Wir besetzen diese Stelle am Standort Düsseldorf für die Vodafone GmbH.

Was wir Dir bieten:

  • Flexibilität: Hybrid Working ermöglicht Dir die Arbeit im Büro oder bis zu 3 Tage/Woche aus dem Homeoffice. Zusätzlich kannst Du bis zu 20 Tage pro Jahr im EU-Ausland sowie in immer mehr Nicht-EU-Ländern arbeiten
  • Attraktive Vergütung und Altersvorsorge: Als Tarif-Mitarbeiter:in bekommst Du je nach Vergütungsmodell Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld oder ein 13. Gehalt. Und mit unserem Pensionsplan auch eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Weiterbildung: Du entscheidest, mit welchen unserer Lern- und Trainingsprogrammen Du Deine individuelle Entwicklung förderst
  • Work-Life-Balance: Ob Kita, Gesundheits- & Achtsamkeitsprogramme oder Fitnessstudio: Du gestaltest flexibel Deinen Job und Dein Privatleben. Wir unterstützen Dich. Auch bei der Pflege von Angehörigen
  • Rabatte und Zusatzleistungen: Als Mitarbeiter:in bekommst Du besondere Angebote auf alle unsere Produkte für Mobilfunk, Festnetz, Internet und TV


Wer wir sind:

Vodafone feiert und fördert Diversität und Inklusion. Wir sind so verschieden wie unsere Kund:innen und unsere Gesellschaft. Ob ethnische Herkunft, Hautfarbe, Alter, Geschlechtsidentität, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung, Religion, politische Zugehörigkeit, Gewerkschaftszugehörigkeit, Nationalität, Gesundheitszustand, soziale Herkunft oder kultureller Hintergrund: Bei Vodafone ist kein Platz für Diskriminierung.

Together we can.

title: Applied AI Engineer (all genders)
sector: Advertising Services, Technology, Information and Internet, and Online Audio and Video Media
description: AI verändert, wie Unternehmen Wissen nutzen, Entscheidungen treffen, zusammenarbeiten und Wert schaffen. Genau daran arbeiten wir bei Plan.Net Agentic AI .Wir begleiten nationale und internationale Unternehmen auf dem Weg zu AI-first Organisationen. Dafür verbinden wir Strategie, neue Arbeitsweisen, Enablement und die Entwicklung konkreter AI-Produkte. Wir bauen eine hybride KI-Infrastruktur aus offenen und proprietären Sprachmodellen, einer zentralen Wissensbasis, einem Gedächtnis für Marken und Unternehmen sowie Agenten, die in Strategie, Kreation, Media und Operations aktiv unterstützen.Der Applied AI Engineer (all genders) ist dabei die Person, die aus dieser Infrastruktur die eigentliche Intelligenz macht: Retrieval-Systeme, die die richtige Information finden, und Agenten, die planen, Tools nutzen und sich messbar verbessern. Du arbeitest dabei eng mit den Kolleg:innen zusammen, die die zugrunde liegende Cloud- und Datenplattform bereitstellen und betreiben - deine Systeme laufen auf ihrem Fundament. Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung mit, mit der du eigenständig Entscheidungen triffst, Verantwortung für ein System als Ganzes übernimmst und zu den Konsequenzen deiner Entscheidungen stehst.Woran du arbeiten wirst:Retrieval-Pipelines bauen. Du entwickelst Chunking- und Embedding-Strategien, Hybrid Search und Re-Ranking für unsere Wissensbasis und unser Markengedächtnis. Agentensysteme bauen. Du baust Agenten, die planen, Tools nutzen und mit anderen Agenten koordinieren, mit Human-in-the-Loop-Absicherung, wo Urteilsvermögen gefragt ist. Qualität messbar machen. Du baust die Evaluations-Harness und Regressionstests für Prompts und Agenten und nutzt Observability-Tools (z. B. LangSmith), um Qualität, Kosten und Latenz laufend zu verbessern. Mit Pilotteams arbeiten. Du bringst Agenten aus dem Prototyp in echte Workflows und passt sie anhand des echten Einsatzes an. Entscheidungen verantworten. Du triffst Entscheidungen zu Retrieval-Strategie, Agenten-Frameworks und Evaluationsstandards eigenständig, legst Trade-offs offen und vertrittst sie gegenüber Stakeholdern. Zusammenarbeit sicherstellen. Du stimmst dich eng mit den Kolleg:innen ab, die die zugrunde liegende Infrastruktur bereitstellen, damit Übergaben reibungslos funktionieren. Was dich auszeichnet:Du hast 1–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Applied AI, Machine Learning Engineering oder vergleichbar, davon mehrere Jahre hands-on in Produktion. Du hast RAG-Systeme gebaut und hast Lust, dich in Richtung komplexerer, agentischer Systeme weiterzuentwickeln: mit Planung, Tool-Nutzung und Multi-Agent-Koordination. Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit Chunking- und Embedding-Strategien, Hybrid Search, Re-Ranking und Vector-Datenbanken Du hast mit mindestens einem LLM-Framework (z. B. LangChain) und einem Agenten-Harness (z. B. pi oder vergleichbar) gearbeitet. Du hast Evaluations- und Observability-Tools wie LangSmith oder vergleichbare Lösungen selbst aufgebaut oder aktiv genutzt. Du schreibst starken Python-Code und hast ein solides Grundverständnis von Cloud-Umgebungen und Containerisierung - genug, um deine eigenen Services innerhalb einer bestehenden Infrastruktur zu deployen. Du kannst technische Entscheidungen fundiert begründen, legst Trade-offs offen und stehst zu den Konsequenzen deiner Entscheidungen. Du bist es gewohnt, die Qualität eines Systems End-to-End zu verantworten, auch ohne dass dir jemand die Architektur bereits vorgibt. Du bist neugierig, eignest dir neue Tools und Konzepte schnell an und willst dich sichtbar weiterentwickeln. Was du bei uns gewinnen kannst:Verantwortung für Agenten und Retrieval-Systeme, die wirklich in Produktion laufen, mit direktem Bezug zur KI-Zukunft der Gruppe. Nähe zu Entscheidungen über Modelle, Frameworks und Evaluationsstandards. Ein Umfeld, das dich technisch fordert und in dem gute Ideen schnell zu echten Systemen werden. Raum, dich Richtung Retrieval-/Agenten-Architektur oder technische Führung weiterzuentwickeln, je nachdem, wohin du willst. Was wir dir bieten:Onboarding: Durch persönliches Mentoring und digitale Onboarding-Sessions - wir sorgen für Deinen perfekten EinstiegWeiterbildung: Deine Entwicklung ist uns wichtig. Ob durch unser internes Campus-Weiterbildungsprogramm zur Erweiterung Deiner Fach-, Methoden- oder Persönlichkeitskompetenzen, freiwillige Sprachkurse oder regelmäßige Coachings - wir halten Dich up to dateFlexibilität: Durch flexible Arbeitszeiten, Mobile Office und Jobsharing-Modelle kannst Du Deinen Beruf an Dein Leben anpassen – und nicht andersrumFun: Wer arbeitet, muss auch mal eine Pause machen – bei uns hast Du durch regelmäßige After Work und Team Events genug Möglichkeiten (auch virtuell, wenn’s sein muss)Sport: Großes Sportprogramm sowie Mobilität durch Agenturfahrräder und E-Bikes/E-Bike LeasingErreichbarkeit: Unser modernes Office im Kreativviertel Münchens ist dank perfekter Lage gut für Dich erreichbarInternationalität: Als international agierende Agenturgruppe bieten wir Dir die Möglichkeit, Dich mit Kolleg:innen aus den unterschiedlichsten Disziplinen aus der ganzen Welt zu vernetzen und auszutauschenSo kannst du dich bewerben:Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf oder einen kurzen Überblick über deinen bisherigen Weg. Noch wichtiger sind ein bis drei konkrete Beispiele: Was hast du selbst angestoßen, organisiert, gebaut, verbessert oder zu Ende gebracht? Das können eigene Initiativen, Kundenarbeit, Prototypen oder Community-Projekte sein.

descriptionHtml:
Einleitung

Der HTGF gehört zu den aktivsten Frühphasen‑Investoren in Europa. Um unsere internen Prozesse weiter zu professionalisieren und Innovationen voranzutreiben, bauen wir unsere IT‑ und Datenlandschaft gezielt aus. Dafür suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt am Standort Bonn eine:n AI Engineer unbefristet in Vollzeit.

Was Dich erwartet

Als AI Engineer (m/w/d) bist du Teil des 8-köpfigen IT-Teams und übernimmst die Verantwortung für die interne Entwicklung von KI-Lösungen sowie die Gestaltung von Architektur und Roadmap. Du bist für die Bereitstellung und den Betrieb der KI-Infrastruktur für das gesamte Unternehmen zuständig. Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören u.a.:

  • KI-Lösungsentwicklung: Konzeption und Implementierung von KI-Agenten, Automatisierungen, RAG-Systemen und weiteren LLM-basierten Anwendungen
  • Datenintegration & Konnektivität: Entwicklung von ETL-Pipelines und API-Integrationen zur Anbindung interner Datenquellen (CRM, ERP, DMS) an LLM-Systeme
  • LLM-Monitoring & Evaluation: Aufbau von Metriken und Monitoring für LLM-Performance, Halluzinationsraten und Kosten
  • Business-Anwendungsentwicklung: Weiterentwicklung von Dynamics 365 Lösungen und zugehörigen Backend-Services

Das zeichnet Dich aus

Du siehst dich als proaktiver Engineer und möchtest unsere Tech-Roadmap aktiv mitgestalten? Das bringst du idealerweise für diese Rolle mit:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium: Informatik, Mathematik, Ingenieurwesen oder vergleichbare IT-Ausbildung
  • Full-Stack-Entwicklungsexpertise: Min. 3–4 Jahre Erfahrung über den gesamten Tech-Stack, idealerweise auf Mid- bis Senior-Level
  • Fokus auf Agentic Engineering: Starke Adoption von KI-gestützten Entwicklungstools (z. B. Cursor, Claude Code) sowie Verständnis von KI-fokussierter Architektur (MCPs)
  • GenAI & Prompt Engineering: Praktische Erfahrung mit generativer KI, Prompt-Design und AI-enabled SaaS-Entwicklung
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript sowie SQL-Datenbanken (PostgreSQL, MySQL)
  • Growth Mindset: Hohe Lernbereitschaft und Experimentierfreude
  • Fließendes Deutsch (C1/C2) und konversationssichere Englischkenntnisse (B1/B2)

Über uns

Deutschland und Europa brauchen ein neues Wirtschaftswunder, wir legen das Fundament. Wir sind der aktivste VC-Investor Deutschlands und finanzieren die Deep-Tech-, Life-Sciences- und Digital-Tech-Unternehmen, die technologische Souveränität sichern und industrielle Substanz schaffen. Von der ersten Idee bis zur internationalen Skalierung begleiten wir mutige Gründer:innen als Multi-Stage-VC-Plattform – nahtlos, verlässlich und langfristig.

350 aktive Startups. 200+ Exits, darunter 4 Unicorns. Über 10 Mrd. € Folgefinanzierungen mobilisiert. Gemeinsam mit dem DTCF bündeln wir mehr als 3 Mrd. € Fondsvolumen – und machen aus deutschen und europäischen Innovationen globale Tech-Champions.

Wir sind ein Team - mit über 100 begeisterten Kolleg:innen. Der Erfolg unserer Startups ist unsere gemeinsame Mission.

Worauf Du Dich freuen kannst

  • Remote, Hybrid, Präsenz - die Mischung macht`s. Neben gemeinsamen regelmäßigen Office-Tagen arbeiten wir zeitlich und örtlich flexibel
  • 30 Tage Urlaub, zzgl. Weihnachten, Neujahr, Rosenmontag und Sonderurlaub
  • Weitere Angebote und Möglichkeiten wie z.B.: Corporate Fitness, Bike-Leasing, Vermögenswirksame Leistungen, Jobticket, Coachings und Weiterbildungen

descriptionHtml:
At Helmholtz Munich, we develop groundbreaking solutions for a healthier society in a rapidly changing world. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation. Through strong partnerships, we accelerate the transfer of new ideas from the lab to real-life applications, improving lives.

What biological information is hidden in biomedical imaging data – and how can we extract it reliably? The Institute for Biological and Medical Imaging (IBMI) is looking for a curious and persistent PhD candidate (f/m/x) who wants to discover new biological and medical insights from cutting-edge imaging and sensing technologies. You will work at the interface of data science, imaging technology and biomedical research, developing analysis strategies for complex real-world datasets ranging from preclinical experiments to human studies.

We are looking for someone who enjoys understanding complex datasets in depth: identifying limitations and confounders, working with developers to understand the imaging pipeline, and finding robust ways to extract biological information even when datasets are small, heterogeneous or noisy. We value scientific curiosity and persistence over blind application of standard pipelines. The right candidate will want to understand why an analysis works, what information it uses, when it fails, and how confident we can be in its conclusions.

Your tasks

  • You will work with unique datasets generated by cutting-edge optoacoustic imaging and sensing technologies, with the goal of discovering biological and medical information that has not yet been fully exploited.
  • You will have the freedom to ask what information is contained in these data and develop the computational and statistical approaches needed to extract it.
  • Working closely with experts in imaging technology, algorithm development, biology, and medicine, you will be able to understand the entire path from physical measurements to biological interpretation and develop robust analysis approaches tailored to challenging real-world biomedical data.

You will have the opportunity to:

  • Analyze unique preclinical and clinical imaging datasets and uncover novel biological and medical insights.
  • Develop innovative data analysis, image analysis, statistical, and machine learning methods, choosing the approach that best fits the scientific question.
  • Investigate systematically what information is contained in imaging data, how it can be extracted, and how confidently conclusions can be drawn.
  • Develop and apply approaches for uncertainty quantification, robust inference, and validation of biomedical imaging results.
  • Work directly with biologists, biomedical researchers, and clinicians to formulate relevant questions and interpret findings in their biological and medical context.
  • Contribute to turning advanced imaging and sensing technologies into tools that generate new biological understanding and clinically relevant information.

Your profile

  • Master Degree in Data Science, Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science or related disciplines with a strong academic record.
  • Strong background in data analysis, statistics, machine learning, scientific computing, or related computational methods.
  • Strong programming skills, preferably in Python, and experience working with scientific data.
  • Strong interest in using computational methods to discover biological or medical insights from imaging and sensing data.
  • Curiosity and willingness to engage with both the technical foundations of imaging methods and the biological or medical questions behind the data.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Independent, proactive, and collaborative working style.
  • Excellent communication skills and fluency in English.
  • Enthusiasm for interdisciplinary teamwork in an international research environment.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Strong knowledge of statistics, statistical learning, or probabilistic modeling.
  • Experience collaborating with experimental scientists, biologists, or clinicians.
  • Interest or experience in LLMs, tool-using agents, or agentic workflows.
  • Experience in optoacoustics, ultrasound, optical imaging, spectroscopy, or related technologies.
  • Interest in entrepreneurship, innovation transfer, or commercialization.
  • Fluency in German

This position is embedded within major research and innovation programs funded by the European Union and the German government and offers exceptional opportunities for scientific visibility, professional growth, and future leadership.

Remuneration and social security benefits are based on the German Collective Wage Agreement for Public-Sector Employees at Federal Level (EG 13 50% TV EntgO Bund). In addition, there is also the possibility of receiving an allowance if the applicable conditions are met. The position has an (initial) fixed term of three years but may be extended under certain circumstances.

Managing Director Mike Frieser:

„We believe that diversity is the key to groundbreaking research and innovative solutions. Our flexible working models and remote options create a supportive environment for balancing work and family life. For us, contributing to a healthier society in such an inspiring workplace is truly meaningful.“

Get to know us

Benefits

  • Scientific Training: Helmholtz Munich Graduate School
  • Career counseling: Career Center for PhD candidates
  • Scientific Resources: State-of-the-art infrastruture and Core Facilities
  • Health Promotion: Sports, company doctor, mental health initiatives
  • International Staff Service: Support with the relocation and integration process in Germany

Interested in applying?

If you have any questions, feel free to contact Dr. Dominik Jüstel, +49 89 4140 9165, who will be happy to help.

Our recruiting is decentralized - your application will be reviewed directly by the specialist department in which you could work in the future.

More information about our application process

Please send your application only via our online application tool and with the following documents:

  • CV
  • Letter of motivation
  • Academic transcripts of records
  • Letter of motivation
  • Academic transcripts of records

If you have obtained a university degree abroad, we will require further documents from you regarding the comparability of your degree by the time you start work at the latest. Please request the Statement of Comparability for Foreign Higher Education Qualifications as early as possible.

We are committed to promoting a culture of diversity and welcome applications from talented people regardless of gender, cultural background, nationality, ethnicity, sexual identity, physical abilities, religion or age. Qualified applicants with physical disabilities will be given preference.

Learn more about diversity at Helmholtz Munich

Our commitment

NCS is a leading AI Tech Services company. With a 15,000-strong team across the Asia Pacific, NCS scales its platforms and capabilities to provide clients with greater agility and AI expertise across a range of Industries. Embracing a strong ecosystem of global partners, NCS transforms technology services delivery combining AI with digital resilience to drive real business impact. NCS is a subsidiary of the Singtel Group.


As a Senior / AI Native Builders in AI Central, you will help build, productise, and deploy AI-powered products, MVPs, reusable assets, and new ventures for regulated and mission-critical sectors. You will work in live client contexts, turning ambiguous business challenges into working solutions that can be tested, adopted, and scaled across Singapore and the wider Asia Pacific region.


AI Central is NCS’s enterprise AI capability spine, responsible for building differentiated AI platforms and reusable assets across sectors such as aviation, land transport, public safety, telecommunications, and government.


What will you do?


AI Product & Solution Delivery

  • Lead the journey from client problem statement to working prototype, MVP, or deployable AI solution.
  • Translate ambiguous business challenges into clear product hypotheses, technical approaches, and execution plans.
  • Build and ship AI-enabled solutions using software engineering, model orchestration, automation, and design tools.
  • Drive fast experiments and iterative delivery cycles to validate desirability, feasibility, and business value.


Client Advisory & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Work directly with client technology and business leaders to understand business needs and shape AI-enabled products.
  • Advise senior stakeholders on AI investment priorities, architecture decisions, and build-versus-buy choices.
  • Challenge assumptions constructively and help create clarity through practical, outcome-focused execution.


AI Engineering, Quality & Delivery Judgement

  • Make sound trade-offs across speed, quality, security, scalability, maintainability, and business value.
  • Apply modern AI tooling, including LLM application patterns, orchestration frameworks, automation platforms, evaluation approaches, and model limitations.
  • Balance rapid experimentation with strong engineering discipline, especially in enterprise and regulated environments.


Reusable Assets, Methodology & Scaling

  • Own the AI delivery methodology for your assigned sector vertical.
  • Build and maintain reusable patterns, playbooks, and working practices that help NCS scale AI-native delivery across sectors and geographies.
  • Document and abstract solutions from Singapore lighthouse accounts so they can be adapted for regional deployment.


Team Enablement & Capability Building

  • Support the technical onboarding and capability development of engineers joining your team.
  • Share what works across AI Central and contribute to the broader adoption of AI-native delivery practices within NCS.
  • Stay current with emerging AI tools, methods, and frameworks, applying them where they create measurable advantage.


The ideal candidate should possess:

  • Strong hands-on engineering ability in Python, JavaScript, or similar languages, with experience building and integrating production-grade applications.
  • Demonstrated 1-3 years of experience delivering AI, machine learning, or generative AI solutions in real-world settings.
  • Strong understanding of modern AI tooling, including LLM application patterns, orchestration frameworks, automation platforms, evaluation approaches, and model limitations.
  • Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and deliver outcomes at pace.
  • Strong product instinct, engineering depth, business acumen, critical thinking, and technical judgement.
  • Ability to balance experimentation with security, reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to translate business needs into technical execution and advise at executive level.
  • Comfort working with senior stakeholders and challenging assumptions constructively.
  • Fluency in using AI as a practical multiplier across design, code, research, documentation, and delivery.
  • A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience is also valued.


Good to have

  • Experience in consulting, venture building, startup environments, or innovation teams.
  • Experience deploying AI solutions in enterprise or regulated environments such as aviation, land transport, public safety, telecommunications, or government.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms, APIs, CI/CD, analytics, and observability.
  • Experience shaping early-stage products with users and iterating based on feedback.
  • Regional exposure, including experience designing or adapting solutions across multiple Asia Pacific markets.


Why Join NCS?

  • Work on cutting-edge AI products that shape the future of technology

descriptionHtml:
Between AI possibilities and engineering reality, there is usually a gap.

➡️ Your job is to close it!

Some of the most valuable expertise at Etteplan has been built over years of solving complex engineering challenges, designing plants and delivering successful projects. Every day, our engineers make critical decisions, solve complex problems and create value for our customers.

Your mission is to identify where AI can support that work, remove unnecessary effort and help engineering teams focus on what they do best.

As an Applied AI Engineer, you bring AI into the day-to-day reality of engineering projects. You work with experienced engineers, understand their challenges and identify where AI can accelerate workflows, improve consistency and create measurable value.

From specifications and datasheets to drawings and engineering documentation, you build practical solutions that help project teams work smarter and deliver faster.

The result is not another AI prototype. It is measurable value in real customer projects: fewer hours per work package, more consistent output, and solutions the project teams keep using after you have moved on to the next case.

What you'll step into:

  • Smart Factory Germany: more than 200 colleagues at five German sites, working across automation, digitalisation and IT/OT
  • Your base is Leverkusen, Berlin, Brunsbüttel, Oberhausen or Wiesloch, hybrid, with the freedom to work where the use case is.
  • Direct access to decision makers: you report to the Vice President Smart Factory Germany and work closely with our Group AI organisation in Finland.
  • Your starting point is electrical engineering and instrumentation, where the opportunity for impact is highest.
  • You are the first person in this role in Germany. The blank page is part of the offer.

Your Mission

🔧 Turn AI into an engineering advantage

You evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify where they can create tangible value for engineering teams. Rather than introducing tools for the sake of innovation, you focus on solutions that improve the way projects are executed.

🧩 Turn engineering challenges into AI opportunities

You work closely with engineering teams to understand where time is lost, information is difficult to access or repetitive tasks slow projects down.

Together, you identify high-value use cases and translate them into practical AI-supported solutions that fit naturally into existing engineering workflows.

⚙️ Prove AI where it matters

You bring AI solutions into live customer projects and validate their impact under real-world conditions. You establish baselines, measure outcomes and demonstrate tangible improvements in efficiency, consistency and delivery performance.

Success isn't determined by how impressive a solution looks. It's determined by whether project teams continue using it after the pilot ends.

🤝 Make it work without you

Everything you build is documented, versioned and handed over so that engineering colleagues can run and extend it themselves. You support our regional network of AI champions with building blocks and hands-on help. A solution that only works while you are in the room does not count.

Who we're looking for

We are looking for a builder.

Someone who enjoys turning ideas into working solutions and who is equally comfortable discussing engineering challenges and AI technologies.

You are curious about what AI can do, but even more interested in what it can achieve in practice.

Most importantly, you care about outcomes, not hype.

What You Bring

✔ Understanding of plant engineering, ideally electrical engineering, instrumentation or automation

✔ Strong affinity for AI, prompting, agents, retrieval and modern AI workflows

✔ Experience working with Python and integrating data sources, tools and APIs

✔ Something you have actually shipped into real use, at work or on your own time

✔ A pragmatic mindset focused on delivery and impact

✔ The ability to bridge engineering expertise and technology

✔ Strong collaboration skills and the patience to work side-by-side with experienced domain experts

✔ Fluent German and English

Nice to have

➕ Experience in process industries such as chemicals, pharmaceuticals or energy

➕ Familiarity with engineering software ecosystems and their interfaces

➕ Experience working with RAG, agents, multimodal AI or retrieval-based solutions

➕ Experience capturing and operationalising expert knowledge

➕ Projects, experiments or side initiatives that demonstrate your curiosity and builder mindset

Between AI possibilities and engineering reality, there is usually a gap.

If you're the person who can close it, we'd love to hear from you.

title: AI Researcher - Post-Training (f/m/d)
description: Who is Sonar?Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow,Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:Committed to our customers and community.Obsessed with quality.Deliberate in our decisions.Effective as one team.With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.Position descriptionAt Sonar, we are seeking an ambitious senior researcher to join our cross-disciplinary team, innovating and developing the next generation of solutions to build enterprise-grade coding agents and models. You will harness Sonar’s deep experience in static analysis, and combine it with your experience and leading techniques in large language model post-training. If you are interested in being hands-on with state-of-the-art research, building practical solutions that deliver high-impact for customers, and working within a team of innovative researchers and engineers, this role is for you.What You Will DoOutcome Driven Development: Work in a team developing and implementing advanced products that enable customers to post-train models to power their agentic coding practices. These agents need to generate high-quality code that meets their enterprise standards and software development best practices. Translate Prototypes to Products: Collaborate closely with researchers, research engineers, MLOps and engineers within the team to design hypotheses and experiments, iterate proofs-of-concept quickly and develop successful prototypes into cutting-edge products. Subject Matter Expert: You will contribute and discuss ideas within our cross-disciplinary team, driving towards the next generation of coding model post-training for enterprises. Spearhead Research & Innovation: Stay up-to-date with the latest LLM and agentic developments; you are driven by learning and teaching others. You will need to explain complex technical details and concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Experience And QualificationsThe ideal candidate will have: An advanced academic background (Master’s or PhD) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field. 4+ years industry experience in machine learning, with a solid understanding of modern software engineering practices and tools. descriptionHtml:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow,Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.
  • SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

  • Committed to our customers and community.
  • Obsessed with quality.
  • Deliberate in our decisions.
  • Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description

At Sonar, we are seeking an ambitious senior researcher to join our cross-disciplinary team, innovating and developing the next generation of solutions to build enterprise-grade coding agents and models. You will harness Sonar’s deep experience in static analysis, and combine it with your experience and leading techniques in large language model post-training. If you are interested in being hands-on with state-of-the-art research, building practical solutions that deliver high-impact for customers, and working within a team of innovative researchers and engineers, this role is for you.

What You Will Do

  • Outcome Driven Development: Work in a team developing and implementing advanced products that enable customers to post-train models to power their agentic coding practices. These agents need to generate high-quality code that meets their enterprise standards and software development best practices.
  • Translate Prototypes to Products: Collaborate closely with researchers, research engineers, MLOps and engineers within the team to design hypotheses and experiments, iterate proofs-of-concept quickly and develop successful prototypes into cutting-edge products.
  • Subject Matter Expert: You will contribute and discuss ideas within our cross-disciplinary team, driving towards the next generation of coding model post-training for enterprises.
  • Spearhead Research & Innovation: Stay up-to-date with the latest LLM and agentic developments; you are driven by learning and teaching others. You will need to explain complex technical details and concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Experience And Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have:

  • An advanced academic background (Master’s or PhD) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field.
  • 4+ years industry experience in machine learning, with a solid understanding of modern software engineering practices and tools.
  • Fluency with Python including core ML frameworks, experience with Rust or any of SonarQube’s flagship languages (C#, C++, JS/TS, Java) is a plus.
  • Expertise in post-training of large language models, including:
    • Policy optimization algorithms (e.g. GRPO, PPO)
    • Verifier-based RL frameworks (RLVR)
    • Supervised fine-tuning (SFT)
    • Data-centric AI methods, including synthetic data and curation
    • Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT)
    • Preference and Safety Alignment
  • Experience of driving research projects, delivering valuable findings and prototypes, and then converting them into products.
  • Excellent communication skills in English and a talent for explaining complex scientific topics clearly and concisely.
Salary range

€90,400 - €166,800 a year

Additional Comments

This role is based in Bochum. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in this location, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.

In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at [email protected] .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

descriptionHtml:
Between AI possibilities and engineering reality, there is usually a gap.

➡️ Your job is to close it!

Some of the most valuable expertise at Etteplan has been built over years of solving complex engineering challenges, designing plants and delivering successful projects. Every day, our engineers make critical decisions, solve complex problems and create value for our customers.

Your mission is to identify where AI can support that work, remove unnecessary effort and help engineering teams focus on what they do best.

As an Applied AI Engineer, you bring AI into the day-to-day reality of engineering projects. You work with experienced engineers, understand their challenges and identify where AI can accelerate workflows, improve consistency and create measurable value.

From specifications and datasheets to drawings and engineering documentation, you build practical solutions that help project teams work smarter and deliver faster.

The result is not another AI prototype. It is measurable value in real customer projects: fewer hours per work package, more consistent output, and solutions the project teams keep using after you have moved on to the next case.

What you'll step into:

  • Smart Factory Germany: more than 200 colleagues at five German sites, working across automation, digitalisation and IT/OT
  • Your base is Leverkusen, Berlin, Brunsbüttel, Oberhausen or Wiesloch, hybrid, with the freedom to work where the use case is.
  • Direct access to decision makers: you report to the Vice President Smart Factory Germany and work closely with our Group AI organisation in Finland.
  • Your starting point is electrical engineering and instrumentation, where the opportunity for impact is highest.
  • You are the first person in this role in Germany. The blank page is part of the offer.

Your Mission

🔧 Turn AI into an engineering advantage

You evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify where they can create tangible value for engineering teams. Rather than introducing tools for the sake of innovation, you focus on solutions that improve the way projects are executed.

🧩 Turn engineering challenges into AI opportunities

You work closely with engineering teams to understand where time is lost, information is difficult to access or repetitive tasks slow projects down.

Together, you identify high-value use cases and translate them into practical AI-supported solutions that fit naturally into existing engineering workflows.

⚙️ Prove AI where it matters

You bring AI solutions into live customer projects and validate their impact under real-world conditions. You establish baselines, measure outcomes and demonstrate tangible improvements in efficiency, consistency and delivery performance.

Success isn't determined by how impressive a solution looks. It's determined by whether project teams continue using it after the pilot ends.

🤝 Make it work without you

Everything you build is documented, versioned and handed over so that engineering colleagues can run and extend it themselves. You support our regional network of AI champions with building blocks and hands-on help. A solution that only works while you are in the room does not count.

Who we're looking for

We are looking for a builder.

Someone who enjoys turning ideas into working solutions and who is equally comfortable discussing engineering challenges and AI technologies.

You are curious about what AI can do, but even more interested in what it can achieve in practice.

Most importantly, you care about outcomes, not hype.

What You Bring

✔ Understanding of plant engineering, ideally electrical engineering, instrumentation or automation

✔ Strong affinity for AI, prompting, agents, retrieval and modern AI workflows

✔ Experience working with Python and integrating data sources, tools and APIs

✔ Something you have actually shipped into real use, at work or on your own time

✔ A pragmatic mindset focused on delivery and impact

✔ The ability to bridge engineering expertise and technology

✔ Strong collaboration skills and the patience to work side-by-side with experienced domain experts

✔ Fluent German and English

Nice to have

➕ Experience in process industries such as chemicals, pharmaceuticals or energy

➕ Familiarity with engineering software ecosystems and their interfaces

➕ Experience working with RAG, agents, multimodal AI or retrieval-based solutions

➕ Experience capturing and operationalising expert knowledge

➕ Projects, experiments or side initiatives that demonstrate your curiosity and builder mindset

Between AI possibilities and engineering reality, there is usually a gap.

If you're the person who can close it, we'd love to hear from you.

Jährlich werden am UKB über eine halbe Million Patienten ambulant und stationär versorgt. Hier studieren rund 3.500 Menschen Medizin und Zahnmedizin, zudem werden jährlich über 600 Personen in Gesundheitsberufen ausgebildet. Mit rund 9.900 Beschäftigten ist das UKB der drittgrößte Arbeitgeber in der Region Bonn/Rhein-Sieg. In Der Nachwuchsgruppe NDEMobil Und Dem Institut Für Digitale Medizin Des Universitätsklinikums Bonn Ist Zum Nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt Folgende Stelle In Vollzeit (38,5 Std./Woche) Zu Besetzen

Wissenschaftliche*r Mitarbeiter*in (m/w/d)

Die Stelle ist befristet bis zum 31.08.2027 zu besetzen.

Das Institut für Digitale Medizin (IDM) am Universitätsklinikum Bonn erforscht und entwickelt datengetriebene Methoden zur Verbesserung von Prävention, Diagnostik und Therapie. Schwerpunkte liegen auf Künstlicher Intelligenz, digitalen Biomarkern, mobilen Gesundheitstechnologien und der Analyse großer Gesundheitsdatenbestände. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit klinischen und technischen Partnern werden innovative digitale Lösungen entwickelt und in die medizinische Versorgung überführt.

Die Nachwuchsgruppe NDEMobil erforscht den Einsatz von Smartphones und Wearables zur Erfassung digitaler Biomarker für neurodegenerative Erkrankungen wie Alzheimer-Demenz und Parkinson. Hierfür entwickeln wir mobile Anwendungen, die aktive und passive Sensordaten sowie Daten aus Wearables erfassen, um Krankheitsverläufe im Alltag besser zu verstehen, frühzeitig zu erkennen und zu überwachen. Unsere Arbeit verbindet mobiles Sensing, Software Engineering und medizinische Forschung mit dem Ziel, skalierbare und nutzerfreundliche digitale Gesundheitstechnologien zu entwickeln.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Konzeption, Durchführung und Auswertung von Studien zur Entwicklung neuer, digitaler Biomarker und/oder
  • Entwicklung von Software und anderen digitalen Lösungen für klinische Fragestellungen und/oder
  • Entwicklung von Methoden für Biosignalverarbeitung und Machine Learning
  • Unterstützung der Lehre im Bereich Softwaretechnologien

Ihr Profil

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik/Computer Science und verwandte Fächer
  • Erfahrung im Bereich Software Engineering und/oder Data Science
  • Interesse an medizinischen Anwendungen und Fragestellungen
  • Hohe Fähigkeit zur selbstständigen, wissenschaftlichen Arbeit

Wir Bieten

  • Mitarbeit an aktuellen Forschungsprojekten im Bereich Digitale Medizin und mobile Gesundheitstechnologien
  • Interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit mit Forschenden aus Informatik, Medizin, Psychologie und Data Science
  • Zugang zu einer exzellenten Forschungsinfrastruktur am Universitätsklinikum Bonn
  • Enge Betreuung und Unterstützung bei der wissenschaftlichen Weiterentwicklung
  • Möglichkeit zur Promotion und zur Veröffentlichung wissenschaftlicher Ergebnisse
  • Teilnahme an nationalen und internationalen wissenschaftlichen Konferenzen
  • Offene, kollegiale Arbeitsatmosphäre in einem motivierten und engagierten Team
  • Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung: flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, Gleitzeit und Homeoffice Möglichkeit
  • Sicher in der Zukunft: Gute Übernahmechancen nach der Ausbildung

Wir setzen uns für Diversität und Chancengleichheit ein. Unser Ziel ist es, den Anteil von Frauen in Bereichen, in denen Frauen unterrepräsentiert sind, zu erhöhen und deren Karrieren besonders zu fördern. Wir fordern deshalb einschlägig qualifizierte Frauen nachdrücklich zur Bewerbung auf. Bewerbungen werden in Übereinstimmung mit dem Landesgleichstellungsgesetz behandelt. Die Bewerbung geeigneter Menschen mit nachgewiesener Schwerbehinderung und diesen gleichgestellten Personen ist besonders willkommen.

descriptionHtml:
Data Scientist (Temporary Freelance Contract)

Location: Berlin, Germany (Hybrid)


About the Company

Join an established international FinTech company that empowers private and professional investors with access to global financial markets through cutting-edge technology. With a strong presence across Europe, the company combines advanced analytics, innovation, and a collaborative culture to build data-driven solutions that directly influence business performance and strategic decision-making.


As a Data Scientist, you will play a key role in transforming complex datasets into actionable insights, predictive models, and business recommendations. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will develop analytical solutions that optimize revenue, support strategic initiatives, and improve business outcomes.


Your Responsibilities

  • Manage the end-to-end process of data-driven knowledge gathering (connect, mine, simulate, predict, illustrate, and deploy)
  • Create data-based solutions to address complex business challenges
  • Translate business needs into hypotheses, leading to advanced analytical projects, and conduct ad hoc analyses to address specific business questions
  • Design, train, deploy and monitor predictive algorithms
  • Development of data-driven business case models
  • Develop and run simulation-based scenarios to quantify revenue and business impact under different assumptions
  • Proactively communicate and share your conclusions, as well as explain complex topics to technical and non-technical stakeholders


Required Qualifications

  • Solid analytical skills in structured and unstructured data (you're a natural problem solver)
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL (you can write advanced queries with ease)
  • A self-driven and proactive attitude
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills (you can explain complex ideas in simple terms)
  • Focus on quality (you strive for excellence in everything you do)
  • Knowledge of financial markets & financial products (options, futures, etc.)
  • Experience with pricing or revenue simulations is a strong advantage


What You'll Get

  • Opportunity to work on high-impact analytical projects with direct business visibility.
  • Exposure to complex financial and commercial datasets.
  • Modern technology stack and data-driven environment.
  • International, collaborative, and innovative workplace.
  • Flat hierarchies with fast decision-making processes.
  • Professional growth through challenging projects and continuous learning.
  • Competitive compensation package.
  • Hybrid working model in Berlin.
  • Temporary contract with the opportunity to contribute to strategic initiatives from day one.

Scientist Plön

Developmental and Evolutionary Biology & Genetics Behavioral Sciences

Job Code: 07-2026

Job Offer from August 13, 2026

The Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Biology in Plön (Germany, Schleswig-Holstein) is an internationally oriented institution whose research focuses on the principles, mechanisms and effects of evolutionary change. Around 200 employees from more than 30 nations currently work at our institute in the departments of Theoretical Biology and Microbial Population Biology, as well as in several independent research groups.

The Genome Facility at the Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Biology in Plön is seeking to fill a position (full-time) of Bioinformatician (m/f/d) to support and expand our core facility services.

The position is offered at the E13 TVöD-Bund level and will initially be limited to two years, with the possibility of extension or transition to a permanent position based on performance.

Responsibilities

  • Analysis of high-throughput sequencing data (e.g., Illumina, PacBio)
  • Development and maintenance of data processing pipelines
  • Support and consultation for researchers on experimental design and data interpretation
  • Close collaboration with the Applications Specialist and other core facility staff

Requirements

  • PhD degree in bioinformatics, computational biology, or related discipline with a minimum of five years post-PhD experience
  • Strong command of Unix/Linux systems and scripting languages (e.g., Python, R, Bash)
  • Experience in routine genome-data management and analysis
  • Ability to produce tailor-made solutions to non-standard problems
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills

What we offer

  • A dynamic, international research environment
  • State-of-the-art infrastructure
  • Opportunities for professional development
  • The possibility of long-term employment following a successful two-year appraisal
  • The working language of the institute is English.

How to apply

Please send your application (including a cover letter, CV, and contact information for two references) as a single PDF file to bewerbung@evolbio.mpg.de.

Application deadline: 31.08.2026.

The Max Planck Society strives for gender equality and diversity. We welcome applications from any background. The Max Planck Society has set itself the goal of employing more severely disabled people. Applications from severely disabled people are expressly welcome. Furthermore, the Max Planck Society aims to increase the proportion of women in areas where they are underrepresented. Women are therefore expressly encouraged to apply.

Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Biology

Administration

24306 Plön

Germany
